ko.title: 10명 중 4명이 미납 중: 학자금 대출 채무 불이행에 관한 새로운 연방 데이터가 영리 대학에 대해 밝힌 것

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Resurfaces in the Numbers
segments.tr: ## 수치에서 다시 드러난 익숙한 패턴

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: Department of Education periodically publishes school-level data on how borrowers are faring with their federal student loans, and the latest release has reignited a long-running debate in higher education policy.
segments.tr: 교육부는 대출자가 연방 학자금 대출을 어떻게 상환하고 있는지에 대한 학교별 데이터를 주기적으로 발표하며, 최근 발표된 자료는 고등 교육 정책에서 오랫동안 이어져 온 논쟁에 다시 불을 지폈습니다.

segments.src: According to the figures, students who attended for-profit colleges are falling behind on their loan payments at roughly twice the rate of students who attended public and nonprofit institutions.
segments.tr: 수치에 따르면, 영리 대학에 다닌 학생들은 공립 및 비영리 기관에 다닌 학생들에 비해 약 두 배 높은 비율로 대출금 상환이 지연되고 있습니다.

segments.src: In some cases, the data point to nonpayment rates approaching four in ten borrowers at certain schools within this sector.
segments.tr: 일부 사례의 경우, 이 부문의 특정 학교에서 대출자 10명 중 4명에 육박하는 미납률을 보이는 것으로 데이터가 가리키고 있습니다.

segments.src: For anyone who has followed the for-profit college story over the past decade and a half, the general shape of these findings will feel familiar.
segments.tr: 지난 15년 동안 영리 대학의 이야기를 지켜봐 온 사람이라면 누구에게나 이러한 조사 결과의 전반적인 형태가 익숙하게 느껴질 것입니다.

segments.src: What's new is the scale and specificity of the data — covering roughly 500 institutions — which gives researchers, lawmakers, and prospective students a clearer picture of where repayment struggles are concentrated.
segments.tr: 새로운 점은 약 500개 기관을 포괄하는 데이터의 규모와 구체성으로, 이를 통해 연구자, 입법자 및 예비 학생들은 상환의 어려움이 어디에 집중되어 있는지 더 명확한 그림을 그릴 수 있게 되었습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Nonpayment Rates Matter
segments.tr: ## 미납률이 중요한 이유

segments.src: "Nonpayment" is a broader measure than the traditional cohort default rate that the Department has reported for years.
segments.tr: "미납"은 교육부가 수년간 보고해 온 전통적인 코호트 채무 불이행률보다 더 광범위한 측정 기준입니다.

segments.src: Rather than only counting borrowers who default outright (typically after 270+ days of missed payments), nonpayment metrics can also capture borrowers who are delinquent, in forbearance, or otherwise not actively paying down their balance.
segments.tr: 단순히 완전히 채무 불이행 상태가 된 대출자(일반적으로 270일 이상 연체된 경우)만 집계하는 대신, 미납 지표는 연체 중이거나, 상환 유예 상태이거나, 그 외에 적극적으로 원금을 상환하지 않고 있는 대출자도 포착할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That makes it a more sensitive early-warning indicator — but also one that requires careful interpretation, since forbearance and deferment are legitimate tools borrowers use during financial hardship, job loss, or continued enrollment.
segments.tr: 따라서 이는 더 민감한 조기 경보 지표가 되지만, 상환 유예 및 납부 연기는 재정적 어려움, 실직 또는 학업 지속 중에 대출자가 사용하는 합법적인 도구이므로 신중한 해석이 필요한 지표이기도 합니다.

segments.src: Analysts caution that a higher nonpayment rate doesn't automatically mean a school is failing its students.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 미납률이 높다고 해서 해당 학교가 학생들을 제대로 가르치지 못하고 있음을 자동으로 의미하는 것은 아니라고 경고합니다.

segments.src: Enrollment patterns matter: for-profit programs have historically served a higher share of working adults, first-generation students, and people returning to education after time in the workforce — groups that, independent of where they studied, tend to carry more financial risk factors going into repayment.
segments.tr: 등록 패턴도 중요합니다. 영리 프로그램은 역사적으로 직장인, 가족 중 첫 대학 진학자, 직장 생활 후 학업으로 복귀하는 사람들의 비율이 더 높았는데, 이들은 공부한 곳과 무관하게 상환 단계에 들어설 때 더 많은 재정적 위험 요인을 안고 가는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Policy Debate This Reopens
segments.tr: ## 다시 열린 정책 논쟁

segments.src: Still, the gap between sectors is large enough that it has revived questions about federal aid eligibility rules, including the Gainful Employment regulation, which ties some career-training programs' access to federal student aid to graduates' debt-to-earnings outcomes.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 부문 간의 격차가 너무 커서, 일부 직업 훈련 프로그램의 연방 학자금 지원 접근권을 졸업생의 소득 대비 부채 비율 결과와 연계하는 '소득창출고용(Gainful Employment)' 규정을 포함하여 연방 지원 자격 규칙에 대한 의문이 다시 제기되고 있습니다.

segments.src: Consumer advocates argue that persistent, sector-wide gaps in repayment outcomes justify tighter accountability standards and clearer consequences for chronically underperforming programs.
segments.tr: 소비자 옹호 단체들은 상환 결과에서 지속적으로 나타나는 부문 전반의 격차가 만성적으로 성과가 저조한 프로그램에 대해 더 엄격한 책무성 기준과 명확한 처벌을 적용하는 것을 정당화한다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Representatives of the for-profit college sector have pushed back on drawing broad conclusions from aggregate data, noting that outcomes vary enormously by program, that many for-profit institutions serve students public and nonprofit schools are less equipped to reach, and that some of the worst-performing actors from a decade ago have already exited the market amid past enforcement actions.
segments.tr: 영리 대학 부문의 대표들은 종합 데이터로부터 광범위한 결론을 도출하는 것에 반대하며, 프로그램에 따라 결과가 크게 다르고, 많은 영리 기관이 공립 및 비영리 학교가 도달하기 어려운 학생들에게 서비스를 제공하고 있으며, 10년 전 가장 성과가 나빴던 기관 중 일부는 과거의 집행 조치 속에서 이미 시장에서 퇴출당했다는 점을 지적했습니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Prospective Students
segments.tr: ## 예비 학생들에게 갖는 의미

segments.src: For borrowers weighing where to enroll, the data is a reminder to look beyond a school's marketing and check publicly available outcome measures before committing to a loan.
segments.tr: 어느 학교에 등록할지 고민하는 대출자들에게 이 데이터는 대출을 결정하기 전에 학교의 마케팅을 넘어 공개적으로 사용 가능한 성과 지표를 확인해야 함을 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: The Department of Education's College Scorecard and similar public tools allow students to compare completion rates, typical debt loads, and repayment outcomes by school and by program — information that can be far more useful than sector-wide averages when making an individual decision.
segments.tr: 교육부의 대학 성적표(College Scorecard) 및 이와 유사한 공개 도구를 통해 학생들은 학교별, 프로그램별 졸업률, 일반적인 부채 부담, 상환 결과를 비교할 수 있으며, 이는 개인적인 결정을 내릴 때 부문 전반의 평균보다 훨씬 더 유용한 정보가 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 그림

segments.src: This release adds another data point to a debate that has run through multiple administrations: how to balance access to postsecondary education — especially for adult and nontraditional learners — against the government's interest in protecting taxpayers and borrowers from programs that leave students worse off financially.
segments.tr: 이번 발표는 여러 정부를 거치며 이어져 온 논쟁에 또 다른 데이터 포인트를 추가합니다. 즉, 특히 성인 및 비전형적 학습자를 위한 고등 교육 기회 제공과, 학생들의 재정 상황을 더 악화시키는 프로그램으로부터 납세자와 대출자를 보호하려는 정부의 이익 사이에서 어떻게 균형을 잡을 것인가 하는 점입니다.

segments.src: Expect continued scrutiny, further rulemaking proposals, and likely pushback from industry groups as regulators digest what this new dataset shows.
segments.tr: 규제 당국이 이 새로운 데이터 세트가 보여주는 내용을 분석함에 따라 지속적인 조사, 추가적인 규칙 제정 제안, 그리고 업계 단체들의 반발이 예상됩니다.

zh.title: 40%的人未能还款：关于学生贷款违约的最新联邦数据揭示了营利性大学的什么

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Resurfaces in the Numbers
segments.tr: ## 数字中再次浮现的熟悉模式

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 美国

segments.src: Department of Education periodically publishes school-level data on how borrowers are faring with their federal student loans, and the latest release has reignited a long-running debate in higher education policy.
segments.tr: 教育部定期发布关于借款人联邦学生贷款偿还情况的学校级数据，最新发布的数据再次引发了高等教育政策中一场长期存在的争论。

segments.src: According to the figures, students who attended for-profit colleges are falling behind on their loan payments at roughly twice the rate of students who attended public and nonprofit institutions.
segments.tr: 根据这些数字，就读于营利性大学的学生贷款逾期率大约是就读于公立和非营利机构的学生的两倍。

segments.src: In some cases, the data point to nonpayment rates approaching four in ten borrowers at certain schools within this sector.
segments.tr: 在某些情况下，数据表明该行业内某些学校的未还款率接近十分之四的借款人。

segments.src: For anyone who has followed the for-profit college story over the past decade and a half, the general shape of these findings will feel familiar.
segments.tr: 对于任何在过去十五年里关注过营利性大学故事的人来说，这些发现的大致轮廓会觉得很熟悉。

segments.src: What's new is the scale and specificity of the data — covering roughly 500 institutions — which gives researchers, lawmakers, and prospective students a clearer picture of where repayment struggles are concentrated.
segments.tr: 新的是数据的规模和具体性——涵盖了大约500所机构——这为研究人员、立法者和潜在学生提供了一幅更清晰的图景，展示了还款困难集中在哪里。

segments.src: ## Why Nonpayment Rates Matter
segments.tr: ## 为什么未还款率很重要

segments.src: "Nonpayment" is a broader measure than the traditional cohort default rate that the Department has reported for years.
segments.tr: "未还款"是一个比教育部多年来报告的传统队列违约率更广泛的指标。

segments.src: Rather than only counting borrowers who default outright (typically after 270+ days of missed payments), nonpayment metrics can also capture borrowers who are delinquent, in forbearance, or otherwise not actively paying down their balance.
segments.tr: 除了仅统计直接违约的借款人（通常在错过还款270天以上之后）之外，未还款指标还可以捕捉到拖欠、处于宽限期或未积极偿还余额的借款人。

segments.src: That makes it a more sensitive early-warning indicator — but also one that requires careful interpretation, since forbearance and deferment are legitimate tools borrowers use during financial hardship, job loss, or continued enrollment.
segments.tr: 这使其成为一个更敏感的早期预警指标——但也需要仔细解读，因为在经济困难、失业或继续入学期间，宽限期和延期是借款人使用的合法工具。

segments.src: Analysts caution that a higher nonpayment rate doesn't automatically mean a school is failing its students.
segments.tr: 分析师警告称，较高的未还款率并不自动意味着学校辜负了学生。

segments.src: Enrollment patterns matter: for-profit programs have historically served a higher share of working adults, first-generation students, and people returning to education after time in the workforce — groups that, independent of where they studied, tend to carry more financial risk factors going into repayment.
segments.tr: 入学模式很重要：营利性项目历来服务于更高比例的在职成年人、第一代大学生以及在重返职场后重新接受教育的人——这些群体无论在哪里学习，在进入还款期时往往承载着更多的财务风险因素。

segments.src: ## The Policy Debate This Reopens
segments.tr: ## 这重新引发的政策辩论

segments.src: Still, the gap between sectors is large enough that it has revived questions about federal aid eligibility rules, including the Gainful Employment regulation, which ties some career-training programs' access to federal student aid to graduates' debt-to-earnings outcomes.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，各板块之间的差距之大，足以重新引发人们对联邦援助资格规则的质疑，包括"有益就业"（Gainful Employment）法规，该法规将一些职业培训项目获得联邦学生援助的资格与毕业生的债务收入比结果挂钩。

segments.src: Consumer advocates argue that persistent, sector-wide gaps in repayment outcomes justify tighter accountability standards and clearer consequences for chronically underperforming programs.
segments.tr: 消费者倡导者认为，还款结果中持续存在的、行业范围内的差距，证明了收紧问责标准以及对长期表现不佳的项目采取更清晰后果的合理性。

segments.src: Representatives of the for-profit college sector have pushed back on drawing broad conclusions from aggregate data, noting that outcomes vary enormously by program, that many for-profit institutions serve students public and nonprofit schools are less equipped to reach, and that some of the worst-performing actors from a decade ago have already exited the market amid past enforcement actions.
segments.tr: 营利性大学行业的代表们反驳了从汇总数据中得出广泛结论的做法，他们指出，不同项目的结果差异巨大，许多营利性机构服务于公立和非营利学校不太有能力接触到的学生，并且在过去执法行动中，十年前表现最差的一些参与者已经退出了市场。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Prospective Students
segments.tr: ## 这对潜在学生意味着什么

segments.src: For borrowers weighing where to enroll, the data is a reminder to look beyond a school's marketing and check publicly available outcome measures before committing to a loan.
segments.tr: 对于权衡在哪里入学的借款人来说，这些数据提醒人们，在承诺贷款之前，要超越学校的营销，查看公开可用的结果指标。

segments.src: The Department of Education's College Scorecard and similar public tools allow students to compare completion rates, typical debt loads, and repayment outcomes by school and by program — information that can be far more useful than sector-wide averages when making an individual decision.
segments.tr: 教育部的大学记分卡（College Scorecard）和类似的公共工具允许学生按学校和项目比较完成率、典型债务负担和还款结果——在做出个人决定时，这些信息可能比全行业平均水平更有用。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 更宏大的图景

segments.src: This release adds another data point to a debate that has run through multiple administrations: how to balance access to postsecondary education — especially for adult and nontraditional learners — against the government's interest in protecting taxpayers and borrowers from programs that leave students worse off financially.
segments.tr: 这一发布为贯穿多届政府的一场辩论增添了另一个数据点：如何在平衡接受高等教育的机会（特别是对于成年和非传统学习者）与政府保护纳税人和借款人免受让学生财务状况恶化的项目侵害的利益之间取得平衡。

segments.src: Expect continued scrutiny, further rulemaking proposals, and likely pushback from industry groups as regulators digest what this new dataset shows.
segments.tr: 随着监管机构消化这一新数据集显示的内容，预计将出现持续的审查、进一步的规则制定提案以及来自行业团体的可能的反弹。

hi.title: 10 में से 4 और भुगतान नहीं: छात्र ऋण चूक पर नया संघीय डेटा फॉर-प्रॉफिट कॉलेजों के बारे में क्या खुलासा करता है

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Resurfaces in the Numbers
segments.tr: ## आंकड़ों में एक परिचित पैटर्न फिर से उभर रहा है

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: अमेरिकी

segments.tr: शिक्षा विभाग समय-समय पर स्कूल-स्तरीय डेटा प्रकाशित करता है कि उधारकर्ता अपने संघीय छात्र ऋणों के साथ कैसा प्रदर्शन कर रहे हैं, और नवीनतम रिलीज ने उच्च शिक्षा नीति में एक लंबे समय से चल रही बहस को फिर से शुरू कर दिया है।

segments.tr: कुछ मामलों में, डेटा इस क्षेत्र के भीतर कुछ स्कूलों में 10 में से चार उधारकर्ताओं के करीब गैर-भुगतान दरों की ओर इशारा करता है।

segments.src: For anyone who has followed the for-profit college story over the past decade and a half, the general shape of these findings will feel familiar.
segments.tr: पिछले डेढ़ दशक से फॉर-प्रॉफिट कॉलेज की कहानी का अनुसरण करने वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति के लिए, इन निष्कर्षों का सामान्य स्वरूप परिचित लगेगा।

segments.src: What's new is the scale and specificity of the data — covering roughly 500 institutions — which gives researchers, lawmakers, and prospective students a clearer picture of where repayment struggles are concentrated.

segments.src: ## Why Nonpayment Rates Matter
segments.tr: ## गैर-भुगतान दरें क्यों मायने रखती हैं

segments.src: "Nonpayment" is a broader measure than the traditional cohort default rate that the Department has reported for years.
segments.tr: "गैर-भुगतान" पारंपरिक कोहोर्ट डिफ़ॉल्ट दर की तुलना में एक व्यापक उपाय है जिसे विभाग ने वर्षों से रिपोर्ट किया है।

segments.src: Rather than only counting borrowers who default outright (typically after 270+ days of missed payments), nonpayment metrics can also capture borrowers who are delinquent, in forbearance, or otherwise not actively paying down their balance.
segments.tr: केवल उन उधारकर्ताओं की गिनती करने के बजाय जो सीधे डिफ़ॉल्ट हो जाते हैं (आमतौर पर 270+ दिनों के छूटे हुए भुगतान के बाद), गैर-भुगतान मेट्रिक्स उन उधारकर्ताओं को भी पकड़ सकते हैं जो अपराधी हैं, फोरबेरेंस में हैं, या अन्यथा सक्रिय रूप से अपनी शेष राशि का भुगतान नहीं कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: That makes it a more sensitive early-warning indicator — but also one that requires careful interpretation, since forbearance and deferment are legitimate tools borrowers use during financial hardship, job loss, or continued enrollment.
segments.tr: यह इसे एक अधिक संवेदनशील प्रारंभिक-चेतावनी संकेतक बनाता है — लेकिन एक ऐसा भी जिसे सावधानीपूर्वक व्याख्या की आवश्यकता है, क्योंकि फोरबेरेंस और आस्थगन वैध उपकरण हैं जिनका उपयोग उधारकर्ता वित्तीय कठिनाई, नौकरी छूटने या निरंतर नामांकन के दौरान करते हैं।

segments.src: Analysts caution that a higher nonpayment rate doesn't automatically mean a school is failing its students.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि उच्च गैर-भुगतान दर का मतलब स्वचालित रूप से यह नहीं है कि एक स्कूल अपने छात्रों को विफल कर रहा है।

segments.src: Enrollment patterns matter: for-profit programs have historically served a higher share of working adults, first-generation students, and people returning to education after time in the workforce — groups that, independent of where they studied, tend to carry more financial risk factors going into repayment.
segments.tr: नामांकन पैटर्न मायने रखते हैं: फॉर-प्रॉफिट कार्यक्रमों ने ऐतिहासिक रूप से कामकाजी वयस्कों, पहली पीढ़ी के छात्रों और कार्यबल में समय बिताने के बाद शिक्षा में लौटने वाले लोगों के एक उच्च हिस्से की सेवा की है — ऐसे समूह जो, जहां उन्होंने अध्ययन किया, उससे स्वतंत्र, पुनर्भुगतान में जाने पर अधिक वित्तीय जोखिम कारकों को वहन करते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Policy Debate This Reopens
segments.tr: ## यह नीतिगत बहस जिसे यह फिर से खोलता है

segments.src: Still, the gap between sectors is large enough that it has revived questions about federal aid eligibility rules, including the Gainful Employment regulation, which ties some career-training programs' access to federal student aid to graduates' debt-to-earnings outcomes.
segments.tr: फिर भी, क्षेत्रों के बीच का अंतर इतना बड़ा है कि इसने संघीय सहायता पात्रता नियमों के बारे में सवालों को पुनर्जीवित कर दिया है, जिसमें गेनफुल एम्प्लॉयमेंट विनियमन शामिल है, जो कुछ करियर-प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रमों की संघीय छात्र सहायता तक पहुंच को स्नातकों के ऋण-से-आय परिणामों से जोड़ता है।

segments.src: Consumer advocates argue that persistent, sector-wide gaps in repayment outcomes justify tighter accountability standards and clearer consequences for chronically underperforming programs.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता अधिवक्ता तर्क देते हैं कि पुनर्भुगतान परिणामों में लगातार, क्षेत्र-व्यापी अंतराल सख्त जवाबदेही मानकों और पुराने रूप से कम प्रदर्शन करने वाले कार्यक्रमों के लिए स्पष्ट परिणामों को सही ठहराते हैं।

segments.src: Representatives of the for-profit college sector have pushed back on drawing broad conclusions from aggregate data, noting that outcomes vary enormously by program, that many for-profit institutions serve students public and nonprofit schools are less equipped to reach, and that some of the worst-performing actors from a decade ago have already exited the market amid past enforcement actions.
segments.tr: फॉर-प्रॉफिट कॉलेज क्षेत्र के प्रतिनिधियों ने कुल डेटा से व्यापक निष्कर्ष निकालने पर पीछे धकेल दिया है, यह देखते हुए कि परिणाम कार्यक्रम के अनुसार बहुत भिन्न होते हैं, कि कई फॉर-प्रॉफिट संस्थान उन छात्रों की सेवा करते हैं जिन्हें सार्वजनिक और गैर-लाभकारी स्कूल तक पहुंचने के लिए कम सुसज्जित हैं, और यह कि एक दशक पहले के कुछ सबसे खराब प्रदर्शन करने वाले अभिनेता पहले ही पिछले प्रवर्तन कार्यों के बीच बाजार से बाहर निकल चुके हैं।

segments.src: ## What It Means for Prospective Students
segments.tr: ## संभावित छात्रों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: For borrowers weighing where to enroll, the data is a reminder to look beyond a school's marketing and check publicly available outcome measures before committing to a loan.
segments.tr: नामांकन के लिए वजन करने वाले उधारकर्ताओं के लिए, डेटा स्कूल के विपणन से परे देखने और ऋण के लिए प्रतिबद्ध होने से पहले सार्वजनिक रूप से उपलब्ध परिणाम उपायों की जांच करने के लिए एक अनुस्मारक है।

segments.src: The Department of Education's College Scorecard and similar public tools allow students to compare completion rates, typical debt loads, and repayment outcomes by school and by program — information that can be far more useful than sector-wide averages when making an individual decision.
segments.tr: शिक्षा विभाग का कॉलेज स्कोरकार्ड और इसी तरह के सार्वजनिक उपकरण छात्रों को स्कूल और कार्यक्रम के अनुसार पूर्णता दर, विशिष्ट ऋण भार और पुनर्भुगतान परिणामों की तुलना करने की अनुमति देते हैं — ऐसी जानकारी जो व्यक्तिगत निर्णय लेते समय क्षेत्र-व्यापी औसत से कहीं अधिक उपयोगी हो सकती है।

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## बड़ी तस्वीर

segments.src: This release adds another data point to a debate that has run through multiple administrations: how to balance access to postsecondary education — especially for adult and nontraditional learners — against the government's interest in protecting taxpayers and borrowers from programs that leave students worse off financially.
segments.tr: यह रिलीज एक ऐसी बहस में एक और डेटा बिंदु जोड़ती है जो कई प्रशासनों के माध्यम से चली है: पोस्ट-सेकेंडरी शिक्षा तक पहुंच को कैसे संतुलित किया जाए — विशेष रूप से वयस्क और गैर-पारंपरिक शिक्षार्थियों के लिए — उन कार्यक्रमों से करदाताओं और उधारकर्ताओं की रक्षा करने में सरकार के हित के खिलाफ जो छात्रों को आर्थिक रूप से बदतर स्थिति में छोड़ देते हैं।

segments.src: Expect continued scrutiny, further rulemaking proposals, and likely pushback from industry groups as regulators digest what this new dataset shows.
segments.tr: निरंतर जांच, आगे के नियम-निर्माण प्रस्तावों, और उद्योग समूहों से संभावित धक्का-मुक्की की अपेक्षा करें क्योंकि नियामक यह पचाते हैं कि यह नया डेटासेट क्या दिखाता है।

es.title: 4 de cada 10 y sin pagar: lo que revelan los nuevos datos federales sobre los impagos de préstamos estudiantiles en las universidades con fines de lucro

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Resurfaces in the Numbers
segments.tr: ## Un patrón familiar resurge en las cifras

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: El

segments.src: Department of Education periodically publishes school-level data on how borrowers are faring with their federal student loans, and the latest release has reignited a long-running debate in higher education policy.
segments.tr: Departamento de Educación de EE. UU. publica periódicamente datos a nivel escolar sobre cómo les va a los prestatarios con sus préstamos estudiantiles federales, y la última publicación ha reavivado un debate de larga data en la política de educación superior.

segments.src: According to the figures, students who attended for-profit colleges are falling behind on their loan payments at roughly twice the rate of students who attended public and nonprofit institutions.
segments.tr: Según las cifras, los estudiantes que asistieron a universidades con fines de lucro se están retrasando en los pagos de sus préstamos a una tasa aproximadamente dos veces mayor que la de los estudiantes que asistieron a instituciones públicas y sin fines de lucro.

segments.src: In some cases, the data point to nonpayment rates approaching four in ten borrowers at certain schools within this sector.
segments.tr: En algunos casos, los datos apuntan a tasas de impago que se acercan a cuatro de cada diez prestatarios en ciertas escuelas dentro de este sector.

segments.src: For anyone who has followed the for-profit college story over the past decade and a half, the general shape of these findings will feel familiar.
segments.tr: Para cualquiera que haya seguido la historia de las universidades con fines de lucro durante la última década y media, la forma general de estos hallazgos resultará familiar.

segments.src: What's new is the scale and specificity of the data — covering roughly 500 institutions — which gives researchers, lawmakers, and prospective students a clearer picture of where repayment struggles are concentrated.
segments.tr: Lo nuevo es la escala y la especificidad de los datos (que cubren aproximadamente 500 instituciones), lo que brinda a los investigadores, legisladores y futuros estudiantes una imagen más clara de dónde se concentran las dificultades de pago.

segments.src: ## Why Nonpayment Rates Matter
segments.tr: ## Por qué importan las tasas de impago

segments.src: "Nonpayment" is a broader measure than the traditional cohort default rate that the Department has reported for years.
segments.tr: "Impago" es una medida más amplia que la tasa de incumplimiento de cohorte tradicional que el Departamento ha reportado durante años.

segments.src: Rather than only counting borrowers who default outright (typically after 270+ days of missed payments), nonpayment metrics can also capture borrowers who are delinquent, in forbearance, or otherwise not actively paying down their balance.
segments.tr: En lugar de contar solo a los prestatarios que incumplen directamente (generalmente después de más de 270 días de pagos atrasados), las métricas de impago también pueden capturar a los prestatarios que están en mora, en indulgencia o que, de otro modo, no están pagando activamente su saldo.

segments.src: That makes it a more sensitive early-warning indicator — but also one that requires careful interpretation, since forbearance and deferment are legitimate tools borrowers use during financial hardship, job loss, or continued enrollment.
segments.tr: Eso lo convierte en un indicador de alerta temprana más sensible, pero también en uno que requiere una interpretación cuidadosa, ya que la indulgencia y el aplazamiento son herramientas legítimas que los prestatarios utilizan durante dificultades financieras, pérdida de empleo o inscripción continua.

segments.src: Analysts caution that a higher nonpayment rate doesn't automatically mean a school is failing its students.
segments.tr: Los analistas advierten que una tasa de impago más alta no significa automáticamente que una escuela esté fallando a sus estudiantes.

segments.src: Enrollment patterns matter: for-profit programs have historically served a higher share of working adults, first-generation students, and people returning to education after time in the workforce — groups that, independent of where they studied, tend to carry more financial risk factors going into repayment.
segments.tr: Los patrones de inscripción importan: los programas con fines de lucro históricamente han servido a una mayor proporción de adultos trabajadores, estudiantes de primera generación y personas que regresan a la educación después de un tiempo en la fuerza laboral, grupos que, independientemente de dónde estudiaron, tienden a tener más factores de riesgo financiero al entrar en la etapa de pago.

segments.src: ## The Policy Debate This Reopens
segments.tr: ## El debate político que esto reabre

segments.src: Still, the gap between sectors is large enough that it has revived questions about federal aid eligibility rules, including the Gainful Employment regulation, which ties some career-training programs' access to federal student aid to graduates' debt-to-earnings outcomes.
segments.tr: Aun así, la brecha entre sectores es lo suficientemente grande como para haber revivido preguntas sobre las reglas de elegibilidad para la ayuda federal, incluida la regulación de Empleo Remunerado (Gainful Employment), que vincula el acceso de algunos programas de capacitación profesional a la ayuda estudiantil federal con los resultados de deuda-ingresos de los graduados.

segments.src: Consumer advocates argue that persistent, sector-wide gaps in repayment outcomes justify tighter accountability standards and clearer consequences for chronically underperforming programs.
segments.tr: Los defensores del consumidor argumentan que las brechas persistentes en todo el sector en los resultados de pago justifican estándares de responsabilidad más estrictos y consecuencias más claras para los programas con un desempeño crónicamente bajo.

segments.src: Representatives of the for-profit college sector have pushed back on drawing broad conclusions from aggregate data, noting that outcomes vary enormously by program, that many for-profit institutions serve students public and nonprofit schools are less equipped to reach, and that some of the worst-performing actors from a decade ago have already exited the market amid past enforcement actions.
segments.tr: Los representantes del sector de universidades con fines de lucro se han resistido a sacar conclusiones generales de los datos agregados, señalando que los resultados varían enormemente según el programa, que muchas instituciones con fines de lucro sirven a estudiantes que las escuelas públicas y sin fines de lucro están menos equipadas para alcanzar, y que algunos de los actores con peor desempeño de hace una década ya han salido del mercado en medio de acciones de cumplimiento anteriores.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Prospective Students
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa para los futuros estudiantes

segments.src: For borrowers weighing where to enroll, the data is a reminder to look beyond a school's marketing and check publicly available outcome measures before committing to a loan.
segments.tr: Para los prestatarios que evalúan dónde inscribirse, los datos son un recordatorio para mirar más allá del marketing de una escuela y verificar las medidas de resultados disponibles públicamente antes de comprometerse con un préstamo.

segments.src: The Department of Education's College Scorecard and similar public tools allow students to compare completion rates, typical debt loads, and repayment outcomes by school and by program — information that can be far more useful than sector-wide averages when making an individual decision.
segments.tr: El College Scorecard del Departamento de Educación y herramientas públicas similares permiten a los estudiantes comparar las tasas de finalización, las cargas de deuda típicas y los resultados de pago por escuela y por programa, información que puede ser mucho más útil que los promedios de todo el sector al tomar una decisión individual.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## El panorama general

segments.src: This release adds another data point to a debate that has run through multiple administrations: how to balance access to postsecondary education — especially for adult and nontraditional learners — against the government's interest in protecting taxpayers and borrowers from programs that leave students worse off financially.
segments.tr: Esta publicación añade otro punto de datos a un debate que ha atravesado múltiples administraciones: cómo equilibrar el acceso a la educación postsecundaria, especialmente para estudiantes adultos y no tradicionales, frente al interés del gobierno en proteger a los contribuyentes y prestatarios de programas que dejan a los estudiantes en peor situación financiera.

segments.src: Expect continued scrutiny, further rulemaking proposals, and likely pushback from industry groups as regulators digest what this new dataset shows.
segments.tr: Se espera un escrutinio continuo, más propuestas de reglamentación y probablemente una reacción negativa de los grupos de la industria a medida que los reguladores digieren lo que muestra este nuevo conjunto de datos.

segments.tr: ومع ذلك، فإن الفجوة بين القطاعات كبيرة بما يكفي لإحياء التساؤلات حول قواعد أهلية المساعدات الفيدرالية، بما في ذلك لائحة "التوظيف المربح" (Gainful Employment)، التي تربط وصول بعض برامج التدريب المهني إلى المساعدات الطلابية الفيدرالية بنتائج الديون مقابل الدخل للخريجين.

segments.src: Consumer advocates argue that persistent, sector-wide gaps in repayment outcomes justify tighter accountability standards and clearer consequences for chronically underperforming programs.
segments.tr: يجادل المدافعون عن حقوق المستهلك بأن الفجوات المستمرة على مستوى القطاع في نتائج السداد تبرر معايير مساءلة أكثر صرامة وعواقب أوضح للبرامج ذات الأداء الضعيف المزمن.

segments.src: Representatives of the for-profit college sector have pushed back on drawing broad conclusions from aggregate data, noting that outcomes vary enormously by program, that many for-profit institutions serve students public and nonprofit schools are less equipped to reach, and that some of the worst-performing actors from a decade ago have already exited the market amid past enforcement actions.
segments.tr: دفع ممثلو قطاع الكليات الربحية بالاعتراض على استخلاص استنتاجات واسعة من البيانات الإجمالية، مشيرين إلى أن النتائج تختلف بشكل كبير حسب البرنامج، وأن العديد من المؤسسات الربحية تخدم طلاباً أقل قدرة على الوصول إليهم في المدارس العامة وغير الربحية، وأن بعض الجهات الأسوأ أداءً منذ عقد مضى قد خرجت بالفعل من السوق وسط إجراءات إنفاذ سابقة.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Prospective Students
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا للطلاب المحتملين

segments.src: For borrowers weighing where to enroll, the data is a reminder to look beyond a school's marketing and check publicly available outcome measures before committing to a loan.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للمقترضين الذين يدرسون مكان التسجيل، تعد البيانات تذكيراً للنظر إلى ما هو أبعد من تسويق المدرسة والتحقق من مقاييس النتائج المتاحة للجمهور قبل الالتزام بقرض.

segments.src: The Department of Education's College Scorecard and similar public tools allow students to compare completion rates, typical debt loads, and repayment outcomes by school and by program — information that can be far more useful than sector-wide averages when making an individual decision.
segments.tr: تسمح "بطاقة أداء الكلية" (College Scorecard) التابعة لوزارة التعليم والأدوات العامة المماثلة للطلاب بمقارنة معدلات الإكمال، وأعباء الديون النموذجية، ونتائج السداد حسب المدرسة وحسب البرنامج - وهي معلومات يمكن أن تكون أكثر فائدة بكثير من متوسطات القطاع عند اتخاذ قرار فردي.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## الصورة الأكبر

segments.src: This release adds another data point to a debate that has run through multiple administrations: how to balance access to postsecondary education — especially for adult and nontraditional learners — against the government's interest in protecting taxpayers and borrowers from programs that leave students worse off financially.
segments.tr: يضيف هذا الإصدار نقطة بيانات أخرى إلى جدل استمر عبر إدارات متعددة: كيفية الموازنة بين الوصول إلى التعليم ما بعد الثانوي - خاصة للبالغين والمتعلمين غير التقليديين - وبين مصلحة الحكومة في حماية دافعي الضرائب والمقترضين من البرامج التي تترك الطلاب في وضع مالي أسوأ.

segments.src: Expect continued scrutiny, further rulemaking proposals, and likely pushback from industry groups as regulators digest what this new dataset shows.
segments.tr: توقع استمرار التدقيق، ومزيداً من مقترحات وضع القواعد، ومن المحتمل حدوث رد فعل من مجموعات الصناعة بينما يستوعب المنظمون ما تظهره مجموعة البيانات الجديدة هذه.

fr.title: 4 sur 10 et sans paiement : ce que révèlent les nouvelles données fédérales sur les défauts de paiement des prêts étudiants dans les établissements à but lucratif

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Resurfaces in the Numbers
segments.tr: ## Un schéma familier refait surface dans les chiffres

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Le département de l'Éducation des États-Unis

segments.src: Department of Education periodically publishes school-level data on how borrowers are faring with their federal student loans, and the latest release has reignited a long-running debate in higher education policy.
segments.tr: publie périodiquement des données au niveau des établissements sur la manière dont les emprunteurs gèrent leurs prêts étudiants fédéraux, et la dernière publication a relancé un débat de longue date sur la politique de l'enseignement supérieur.

segments.src: According to the figures, students who attended for-profit colleges are falling behind on their loan payments at roughly twice the rate of students who attended public and nonprofit institutions.
segments.tr: Selon les chiffres, les étudiants ayant fréquenté des établissements à but lucratif accusent un retard dans le remboursement de leurs prêts à un taux environ deux fois plus élevé que les étudiants ayant fréquenté des établissements publics ou à but non lucratif.

segments.src: In some cases, the data point to nonpayment rates approaching four in ten borrowers at certain schools within this sector.
segments.tr: Dans certains cas, les données indiquent des taux de non-paiement approchant quatre emprunteurs sur dix dans certains établissements de ce secteur.

segments.src: For anyone who has followed the for-profit college story over the past decade and a half, the general shape of these findings will feel familiar.
segments.tr: Pour quiconque a suivi l'histoire des établissements d'enseignement à but lucratif au cours des quinze dernières années, la tendance générale de ces résultats semblera familière.

segments.src: What's new is the scale and specificity of the data — covering roughly 500 institutions — which gives researchers, lawmakers, and prospective students a clearer picture of where repayment struggles are concentrated.
segments.tr: Ce qui est nouveau, c'est l'ampleur et la précision des données — couvrant environ 500 établissements — ce qui donne aux chercheurs, aux législateurs et aux futurs étudiants une image plus claire de la concentration des difficultés de remboursement.

segments.src: ## Why Nonpayment Rates Matter
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les taux de non-paiement sont importants

segments.src: "Nonpayment" is a broader measure than the traditional cohort default rate that the Department has reported for years.
segments.tr: Le « non-paiement » est une mesure plus large que le taux de défaut de paiement de cohorte traditionnel que le département publie depuis des années.

segments.src: Rather than only counting borrowers who default outright (typically after 270+ days of missed payments), nonpayment metrics can also capture borrowers who are delinquent, in forbearance, or otherwise not actively paying down their balance.
segments.tr: Plutôt que de ne compter que les emprunteurs en défaut de paiement pur et simple (généralement après plus de 270 jours de paiements manqués), les mesures de non-paiement peuvent également saisir les emprunteurs qui sont en retard, en report de paiement (forbearance), ou qui ne remboursent pas activement leur solde.

segments.src: That makes it a more sensitive early-warning indicator — but also one that requires careful interpretation, since forbearance and deferment are legitimate tools borrowers use during financial hardship, job loss, or continued enrollment.
segments.tr: Cela en fait un indicateur d'alerte précoce plus sensible, mais qui nécessite également une interprétation prudente, car le report de paiement et le différé sont des outils légitimes utilisés par les emprunteurs en cas de difficultés financières, de perte d'emploi ou de poursuite d'études.

segments.src: Analysts caution that a higher nonpayment rate doesn't automatically mean a school is failing its students.
segments.tr: Les analystes préviennent qu'un taux de non-paiement plus élevé ne signifie pas automatiquement qu'un établissement échoue auprès de ses étudiants.

segments.src: Enrollment patterns matter: for-profit programs have historically served a higher share of working adults, first-generation students, and people returning to education after time in the workforce — groups that, independent of where they studied, tend to carry more financial risk factors going into repayment.
segments.tr: Les modèles d'inscription comptent : les programmes à but lucratif ont historiquement servi une part plus importante d'adultes actifs, d'étudiants de première génération et de personnes retournant aux études après un passage dans la vie active — des groupes qui, indépendamment de l'endroit où ils ont étudié, ont tendance à présenter davantage de facteurs de risque financier au moment du remboursement.

segments.src: ## The Policy Debate This Reopens
segments.tr: ## Le débat politique que cela rouvre

segments.src: Still, the gap between sectors is large enough that it has revived questions about federal aid eligibility rules, including the Gainful Employment regulation, which ties some career-training programs' access to federal student aid to graduates' debt-to-earnings outcomes.
segments.tr: Néanmoins, l'écart entre les secteurs est suffisamment important pour avoir relancé les questions sur les règles d'éligibilité à l'aide fédérale, y compris la réglementation sur l'emploi rémunérateur (Gainful Employment), qui lie l'accès de certains programmes de formation professionnelle à l'aide fédérale aux résultats des diplômés en matière de ratio dette/revenu.

segments.src: Consumer advocates argue that persistent, sector-wide gaps in repayment outcomes justify tighter accountability standards and clearer consequences for chronically underperforming programs.
segments.tr: Les défenseurs des consommateurs soutiennent que les écarts persistants à l'échelle du secteur dans les résultats de remboursement justifient des normes de responsabilité plus strictes et des conséquences plus claires pour les programmes dont les performances sont chroniquement insuffisantes.

segments.src: Representatives of the for-profit college sector have pushed back on drawing broad conclusions from aggregate data, noting that outcomes vary enormously by program, that many for-profit institutions serve students public and nonprofit schools are less equipped to reach, and that some of the worst-performing actors from a decade ago have already exited the market amid past enforcement actions.
segments.tr: Les représentants du secteur des établissements à but lucratif se sont opposés à ce que l'on tire des conclusions générales à partir de données agrégées, notant que les résultats varient énormément selon le programme, que de nombreux établissements à but lucratif servent des étudiants que les écoles publiques et à but non lucratif sont moins équipées pour atteindre, et que certains des acteurs les moins performants d'il y a dix ans ont déjà quitté le marché suite à des mesures d'application passées.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Prospective Students
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les futurs étudiants

segments.src: For borrowers weighing where to enroll, the data is a reminder to look beyond a school's marketing and check publicly available outcome measures before committing to a loan.
segments.tr: Pour les emprunteurs qui réfléchissent à l'endroit où s'inscrire, ces données rappellent de regarder au-delà du marketing d'un établissement et de vérifier les mesures de résultats accessibles au public avant de s'engager dans un prêt.

segments.src: The Department of Education's College Scorecard and similar public tools allow students to compare completion rates, typical debt loads, and repayment outcomes by school and by program — information that can be far more useful than sector-wide averages when making an individual decision.
segments.tr: Le College Scorecard du département de l'Éducation et des outils publics similaires permettent aux étudiants de comparer les taux d'obtention de diplôme, les charges de dette typiques et les résultats de remboursement par établissement et par programme — des informations qui peuvent être bien plus utiles que les moyennes sectorielles lors de la prise d'une décision individuelle.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## La situation dans son ensemble

segments.src: This release adds another data point to a debate that has run through multiple administrations: how to balance access to postsecondary education — especially for adult and nontraditional learners — against the government's interest in protecting taxpayers and borrowers from programs that leave students worse off financially.
segments.tr: Cette publication ajoute un point de données supplémentaire à un débat qui a traversé plusieurs administrations : comment équilibrer l'accès à l'enseignement postsecondaire — en particulier pour les apprenants adultes et non traditionnels — avec l'intérêt du gouvernement à protéger les contribuables et les emprunteurs contre les programmes qui laissent les étudiants dans une situation financière pire.

segments.src: Expect continued scrutiny, further rulemaking proposals, and likely pushback from industry groups as regulators digest what this new dataset shows.
segments.tr: Attendez-vous à un examen continu, à d'autres propositions de réglementation et probablement à une résistance de la part des groupes industriels à mesure que les régulateurs digèrent ce que montre ce nouvel ensemble de données.

pt.title: 4 em 10 e Sem Pagar: O que Novos Dados Federais sobre Inadimplência de Empréstimos Estudantis Revelam Sobre Faculdades com Fins Lucrativos

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Resurfaces in the Numbers
segments.tr: ## Um Padrão Familiar Ressurge nos Números

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: O

segments.src: Department of Education periodically publishes school-level data on how borrowers are faring with their federal student loans, and the latest release has reignited a long-running debate in higher education policy.
segments.tr: Departamento de Educação dos EUA publica periodicamente dados em nível escolar sobre como os mutuários estão lidando com seus empréstimos estudantis federais, e a última divulgação reacendeu um debate de longa data na política de ensino superior.

segments.src: According to the figures, students who attended for-profit colleges are falling behind on their loan payments at roughly twice the rate of students who attended public and nonprofit institutions.
segments.tr: De acordo com os números, os estudantes que frequentaram faculdades com fins lucrativos estão ficando para trás em seus pagamentos de empréstimos a uma taxa aproximadamente duas vezes maior do que a dos estudantes que frequentaram instituições públicas e sem fins lucrativos.

segments.src: In some cases, the data point to nonpayment rates approaching four in ten borrowers at certain schools within this sector.
segments.tr: Em alguns casos, os dados apontam para taxas de não pagamento que se aproximam de quatro em dez mutuários em certas escolas dentro deste setor.

segments.src: For anyone who has followed the for-profit college story over the past decade and a half, the general shape of these findings will feel familiar.
segments.tr: Para quem acompanhou a história das faculdades com fins lucrativos na última década e meia, a forma geral dessas conclusões parecerá familiar.

segments.src: What's new is the scale and specificity of the data — covering roughly 500 institutions — which gives researchers, lawmakers, and prospective students a clearer picture of where repayment struggles are concentrated.
segments.tr: O que há de novo é a escala e a especificidade dos dados — cobrindo cerca de 500 instituições — o que dá aos pesquisadores, legisladores e futuros estudantes uma imagem mais clara de onde as dificuldades de reembolso estão concentradas.

segments.src: ## Why Nonpayment Rates Matter
segments.tr: ## Por Que as Taxas de Não Pagamento Importam

segments.src: "Nonpayment" is a broader measure than the traditional cohort default rate that the Department has reported for years.
segments.tr: "Não pagamento" é uma medida mais ampla do que a taxa de inadimplência de coorte tradicional que o Departamento relata há anos.

segments.src: Rather than only counting borrowers who default outright (typically after 270+ days of missed payments), nonpayment metrics can also capture borrowers who are delinquent, in forbearance, or otherwise not actively paying down their balance.
segments.tr: Em vez de apenas contar os mutuários que entram em inadimplência direta (tipicamente após 270+ dias de pagamentos perdidos), as métricas de não pagamento também podem capturar mutuários que estão inadimplentes, em carência, ou de outra forma não pagando ativamente seu saldo.

segments.src: That makes it a more sensitive early-warning indicator — but also one that requires careful interpretation, since forbearance and deferment are legitimate tools borrowers use during financial hardship, job loss, or continued enrollment.
segments.tr: Isso o torna um indicador de alerta precoce mais sensível — mas também um que requer interpretação cuidadosa, uma vez que a carência e o adiamento são ferramentas legítimas que os mutuários usam durante dificuldades financeiras, perda de emprego ou matrícula contínua.

segments.src: Analysts caution that a higher nonpayment rate doesn't automatically mean a school is failing its students.
segments.tr: Os analistas alertam que uma taxa de não pagamento mais alta não significa automaticamente que uma escola está falhando com seus alunos.

segments.src: Enrollment patterns matter: for-profit programs have historically served a higher share of working adults, first-generation students, and people returning to education after time in the workforce — groups that, independent of where they studied, tend to carry more financial risk factors going into repayment.
segments.tr: Os padrões de matrícula importam: os programas com fins lucrativos historicamente atendem a uma proporção maior de adultos trabalhadores, estudantes de primeira geração e pessoas que retornam à educação após o tempo na força de trabalho — grupos que, independentemente de onde estudaram, tendem a carregar mais fatores de risco financeiro ao entrar no reembolso.

segments.src: ## The Policy Debate This Reopens
segments.tr: ## O Debate Político que Isso Reabre

segments.src: Still, the gap between sectors is large enough that it has revived questions about federal aid eligibility rules, including the Gainful Employment regulation, which ties some career-training programs' access to federal student aid to graduates' debt-to-earnings outcomes.
segments.tr: Ainda assim, a lacuna entre os setores é grande o suficiente para ter revivido perguntas sobre as regras de elegibilidade para ajuda federal, incluindo o regulamento de Emprego Remunerado, que vincula o acesso de alguns programas de treinamento de carreira à ajuda estudantil federal aos resultados de dívida em relação aos ganhos dos graduados.

segments.src: Consumer advocates argue that persistent, sector-wide gaps in repayment outcomes justify tighter accountability standards and clearer consequences for chronically underperforming programs.
segments.tr: Os defensores dos consumidores argumentam que lacunas persistentes em todo o setor nos resultados de reembolso justificam padrões de prestação de contas mais rigorosos e consequências mais claras para programas cronicamente com baixo desempenho.

segments.src: Representatives of the for-profit college sector have pushed back on drawing broad conclusions from aggregate data, noting that outcomes vary enormously by program, that many for-profit institutions serve students public and nonprofit schools are less equipped to reach, and that some of the worst-performing actors from a decade ago have already exited the market amid past enforcement actions.
segments.tr: Os representantes do setor de faculdades com fins lucrativos têm resistido a tirar conclusões amplas a partir de dados agregados, observando que os resultados variam enormemente por programa, que muitas instituições com fins lucrativos atendem a estudantes que escolas públicas e sem fins lucrativos estão menos equipadas para alcançar, e que alguns dos atores com pior desempenho de uma década atrás já saíram do mercado em meio a ações de fiscalização anteriores.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Prospective Students
segments.tr: ## O Que Isso Significa para Futuros Estudantes

segments.src: For borrowers weighing where to enroll, the data is a reminder to look beyond a school's marketing and check publicly available outcome measures before committing to a loan.
segments.tr: Para os mutuários que estão avaliando onde se matricular, os dados são um lembrete para olhar além do marketing de uma escola e verificar as medidas de resultado publicamente disponíveis antes de se comprometer com um empréstimo.

segments.src: The Department of Education's College Scorecard and similar public tools allow students to compare completion rates, typical debt loads, and repayment outcomes by school and by program — information that can be far more useful than sector-wide averages when making an individual decision.
segments.tr: O Painel de Controle Universitário do Departamento de Educação e ferramentas públicas semelhantes permitem que os alunos comparem taxas de conclusão, cargas de dívida típicas e resultados de reembolso por escola e por programa — informações que podem ser muito mais úteis do que médias de todo o setor ao tomar uma decisão individual.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## O Panorama Geral

segments.src: This release adds another data point to a debate that has run through multiple administrations: how to balance access to postsecondary education — especially for adult and nontraditional learners — against the government's interest in protecting taxpayers and borrowers from programs that leave students worse off financially.
segments.tr: Esta divulgação adiciona outro ponto de dados a um debate que percorreu várias administrações: como equilibrar o acesso à educação pós-secundária — especialmente para alunos adultos e não tradicionais — contra o interesse do governo em proteger os contribuintes e mutuários de programas que deixam os alunos em situação financeira pior.

segments.src: Expect continued scrutiny, further rulemaking proposals, and likely pushback from industry groups as regulators digest what this new dataset shows.
segments.tr: Espere escrutínio contínuo, novas propostas de regulamentação e provável resistência de grupos da indústria enquanto os reguladores digerem o que este novo conjunto de dados mostra.

in.title: 4 dari 10 dan Tidak Membayar: Apa yang Diungkapkan Data Federal Baru tentang Gagal Bayar Pinjaman Mahasiswa Mengenai Perguruan Tinggi Swasta Berorientasi Laba

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Resurfaces in the Numbers
segments.tr: ## Pola yang Dikenal Muncul Kembali dalam Angka-Angka Ini

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Departemen

segments.src: Department of Education periodically publishes school-level data on how borrowers are faring with their federal student loans, and the latest release has reignited a long-running debate in higher education policy.
segments.tr: Pendidikan A.S. secara berkala mempublikasikan data tingkat sekolah tentang bagaimana para peminjam menjalani pembayaran pinjaman mahasiswa federal mereka, dan rilis terbaru ini telah menyalakan kembali perdebatan panjang dalam kebijakan pendidikan tinggi.

segments.src: According to the figures, students who attended for-profit colleges are falling behind on their loan payments at roughly twice the rate of students who attended public and nonprofit institutions.
segments.tr: Menurut angka-angka tersebut, mahasiswa yang menempuh pendidikan di perguruan tinggi berorientasi laba tertinggal dalam pembayaran pinjaman mereka sekitar dua kali lipat dari tingkat mahasiswa yang menempuh pendidikan di lembaga negeri dan nirlaba.

segments.src: In some cases, the data point to nonpayment rates approaching four in ten borrowers at certain schools within this sector.
segments.tr: Dalam beberapa kasus, data menunjukkan tingkat penunggakan mendekati empat dari sepuluh peminjam di sekolah-sekolah tertentu dalam sektor ini.

segments.src: For anyone who has followed the for-profit college story over the past decade and a half, the general shape of these findings will feel familiar.
segments.tr: Bagi siapa saja yang telah mengikuti kisah perguruan tinggi berorientasi laba selama satu setengah dekade terakhir, bentuk umum dari temuan-temuan ini akan terasa tidak asing.

segments.src: What's new is the scale and specificity of the data — covering roughly 500 institutions — which gives researchers, lawmakers, and prospective students a clearer picture of where repayment struggles are concentrated.
segments.tr: Hal yang baru adalah skala dan spesifisitas data — yang mencakup sekitar 500 lembaga — yang memberikan gambaran lebih jelas kepada para peneliti, pembuat undang-undang, dan calon mahasiswa mengenai di mana masalah pembayaran terkonsentrasi.

segments.src: ## Why Nonpayment Rates Matter
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Tingkat Penunggakan Itu Penting

segments.src: "Nonpayment" is a broader measure than the traditional cohort default rate that the Department has reported for years.
segments.tr: "Penunggakan" adalah ukuran yang lebih luas daripada tingkat gagal bayar kohort tradisional yang telah dilaporkan Departemen selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: Rather than only counting borrowers who default outright (typically after 270+ days of missed payments), nonpayment metrics can also capture borrowers who are delinquent, in forbearance, or otherwise not actively paying down their balance.
segments.tr: Alih-alih hanya menghitung peminjam yang gagal bayar secara langsung (biasanya setelah 270+ hari melewatkan pembayaran), metrik penunggakan juga dapat mencakup peminjam yang menunggak, dalam penundaan (forbearance), atau tidak secara aktif membayar saldo mereka.

segments.src: That makes it a more sensitive early-warning indicator — but also one that requires careful interpretation, since forbearance and deferment are legitimate tools borrowers use during financial hardship, job loss, or continued enrollment.
segments.tr: Hal itu menjadikannya indikator peringatan dini yang lebih sensitif — tetapi juga memerlukan interpretasi yang cermat, karena penundaan (forbearance) dan penangguhan (deferment) adalah alat sah yang digunakan peminjam selama kesulitan keuangan, kehilangan pekerjaan, atau pendaftaran pendidikan lanjutan.

segments.src: Analysts caution that a higher nonpayment rate doesn't automatically mean a school is failing its students.
segments.tr: Para analis memperingatkan bahwa tingkat penunggakan yang lebih tinggi tidak secara otomatis berarti suatu sekolah gagal mendidik mahasiswanya.

segments.src: Enrollment patterns matter: for-profit programs have historically served a higher share of working adults, first-generation students, and people returning to education after time in the workforce — groups that, independent of where they studied, tend to carry more financial risk factors going into repayment.
segments.tr: Pola pendaftaran itu penting: program berorientasi laba secara historis melayani proporsi yang lebih tinggi dari orang dewasa yang bekerja, mahasiswa generasi pertama, dan orang-orang yang kembali ke dunia pendidikan setelah bekerja — kelompok yang, terlepas dari tempat mereka belajar, cenderung membawa lebih banyak faktor risiko keuangan saat memasuki masa pembayaran.

segments.src: ## The Policy Debate This Reopens
segments.tr: ## Perdebatan Kebijakan yang Dibuka Kembali

segments.src: Still, the gap between sectors is large enough that it has revived questions about federal aid eligibility rules, including the Gainful Employment regulation, which ties some career-training programs' access to federal student aid to graduates' debt-to-earnings outcomes.
segments.tr: Meskipun demikian, kesenjangan antar sektor cukup besar sehingga telah menghidupkan kembali pertanyaan tentang aturan kelayakan bantuan federal, termasuk regulasi Gainful Employment, yang mengaitkan akses beberapa program pelatihan karir ke bantuan mahasiswa federal dengan hasil rasio utang terhadap pendapatan lulusan.

segments.src: Consumer advocates argue that persistent, sector-wide gaps in repayment outcomes justify tighter accountability standards and clearer consequences for chronically underperforming programs.
segments.tr: Pembela konsumen berpendapat bahwa kesenjangan berlanjut di seluruh sektor dalam hasil pembayaran membenarkan standar akuntabilitas yang lebih ketat dan konsekuensi yang lebih jelas untuk program-program yang secara kronis berkinerja buruk.

segments.src: Representatives of the for-profit college sector have pushed back on drawing broad conclusions from aggregate data, noting that outcomes vary enormously by program, that many for-profit institutions serve students public and nonprofit schools are less equipped to reach, and that some of the worst-performing actors from a decade ago have already exited the market amid past enforcement actions.
segments.tr: Perwakilan dari sektor perguruan tinggi berorientasi laba menolak penarikan kesimpulan luas dari data agregat, dengan mencatat bahwa hasilnya sangat bervariasi berdasarkan program, bahwa banyak lembaga berorientasi laba melayani mahasiswa yang kurang mampu dijangkau oleh sekolah negeri dan nirlaba, dan bahwa beberapa pelaku berkinerja terburuk dari satu dekade lalu telah keluar dari pasar di tengah tindakan penegakan hukum sebelumnya.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Prospective Students
segments.tr: ## Apa Artimya bagi Calon Mahasiswa

segments.src: For borrowers weighing where to enroll, the data is a reminder to look beyond a school's marketing and check publicly available outcome measures before committing to a loan.

segments.src: The Department of Education's College Scorecard and similar public tools allow students to compare completion rates, typical debt loads, and repayment outcomes by school and by program — information that can be far more useful than sector-wide averages when making an individual decision.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture

segments.src: This release adds another data point to a debate that has run through multiple administrations: how to balance access to postsecondary education — especially for adult and nontraditional learners — against the government's interest in protecting taxpayers and borrowers from programs that leave students worse off financially.

segments.src: Expect continued scrutiny, further rulemaking proposals, and likely pushback from industry groups as regulators digest what this new dataset shows.

ja.title: 10人中4人が未払い：学生ローン債務不履行に関する新たな連邦データが明らかにする営利企業系大学の実態

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Resurfaces in the Numbers
segments.tr: ## 数値に再び現れた見慣れたパターン

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 米国

segments.src: Department of Education periodically publishes school-level data on how borrowers are faring with their federal student loans, and the latest release has reignited a long-running debate in higher education policy.
segments.tr: 教育省は、借り手が連邦学生ローンをどのように返済しているかに関する学校レベルのデータを定期的に公表しており、今回の最新のリリースは高等教育政策における長年の議論を再燃させています。

segments.src: According to the figures, students who attended for-profit colleges are falling behind on their loan payments at roughly twice the rate of students who attended public and nonprofit institutions.
segments.tr: その数値によると、営利企業系大学（for-profit colleges）に通った学生は、公立や非営利の機関に通った学生の約2倍の割合でローン返済が滞っています。

segments.src: In some cases, the data point to nonpayment rates approaching four in ten borrowers at certain schools within this sector.
segments.tr: 一部のケースでは、このセクター内の特定の学校において、借り手の10人中4人近くに達する未払い率がデータで示されています。

segments.src: For anyone who has followed the for-profit college story over the past decade and a half, the general shape of these findings will feel familiar.
segments.tr: 過去15年間にわたり営利企業系大学をめぐる動向を追ってきた人にとって、これらの調査結果の全体的な構図は見慣れたものに感じられるでしょう。

segments.src: What's new is the scale and specificity of the data — covering roughly 500 institutions — which gives researchers, lawmakers, and prospective students a clearer picture of where repayment struggles are concentrated.
segments.tr: 新しいのは、約500の機関をカバーするデータの規模と具体性であり、これにより研究者、政策立案者、そして進学を希望する学生は、返済の困難がどこに集中しているかをより明確に把握できるようになります。

segments.src: ## Why Nonpayment Rates Matter
segments.tr: ## なぜ未払い率が重要なのか

segments.src: "Nonpayment" is a broader measure than the traditional cohort default rate that the Department has reported for years.
segments.tr: 「未払い（Nonpayment）」は、教育省が長年報告してきた従来のコホートデフォルト率（cohort default rate）よりも広範な指標です。

segments.src: Rather than only counting borrowers who default outright (typically after 270+ days of missed payments), nonpayment metrics can also capture borrowers who are delinquent, in forbearance, or otherwise not actively paying down their balance.
segments.tr: 完全に債務不履行に陥った借り手（通常は270日以上の支払い延滞後）のみをカウントするのではなく、未払い指標は、延滞中、支払い猶予（forbearance）中、またはその他の理由で残高を積極的に返済していない借り手も捉えることができます。

segments.src: That makes it a more sensitive early-warning indicator — but also one that requires careful interpretation, since forbearance and deferment are legitimate tools borrowers use during financial hardship, job loss, or continued enrollment.
segments.tr: そのため、より敏感な早期警戒指標となりますが、支払い猶予や返済猶予（deferment）は、経済的困難、失業、または在学継続中に借り手が使用する正当な手段であるため、慎重な解釈が必要な指標でもあります。

segments.src: Analysts caution that a higher nonpayment rate doesn't automatically mean a school is failing its students.
segments.tr: アナリストは、未払い率が高いからといって、自動的にその学校が学生の期待を裏切っていることを意味するわけではないと警告しています。

segments.src: Enrollment patterns matter: for-profit programs have historically served a higher share of working adults, first-generation students, and people returning to education after time in the workforce — groups that, independent of where they studied, tend to carry more financial risk factors going into repayment.
segments.tr: 在籍パターンの影響もあります。営利企業系のプログラムは歴史的に、働く社会人、家族の中で最初の大学進学者、あるいは社会人を経て教育に戻ってきた人々の割合が高く、これらのグループは、どこで学んだかに関わらず、返済開始時により多くの財務的リスク要因を抱える傾向があります。

segments.src: ## The Policy Debate This Reopens
segments.tr: ## 再燃する政策論争

segments.src: Still, the gap between sectors is large enough that it has revived questions about federal aid eligibility rules, including the Gainful Employment regulation, which ties some career-training programs' access to federal student aid to graduates' debt-to-earnings outcomes.
segments.tr: それでも、セクター間の格差は非常に大きく、連邦援助の受給資格ルールに関する疑問が再燃しています。これには、一部のキャリア訓練プログラムの連邦学生援助へのアクセスを卒業生の債務対収入比率（debt-to-earnings）の成果に関連付ける「有益な雇用（Gainful Employment）」規制などが含まれます。

segments.src: Consumer advocates argue that persistent, sector-wide gaps in repayment outcomes justify tighter accountability standards and clearer consequences for chronically underperforming programs.
segments.tr: 消費者擁護派は、返済成果におけるセクター全体の根深い格差は、より厳格な説明責任基準と、慢性的にパフォーマンスの低いプログラムに対するより明確なペナルティを正当化するものだと主張しています。

segments.src: Representatives of the for-profit college sector have pushed back on drawing broad conclusions from aggregate data, noting that outcomes vary enormously by program, that many for-profit institutions serve students public and nonprofit schools are less equipped to reach, and that some of the worst-performing actors from a decade ago have already exited the market amid past enforcement actions.
segments.tr: 営利企業系大学セクターの代表者らは、集計データから大雑把な結論を導き出すことに反発しており、成果はプログラムによって大きく異なること、多くの営利機関は公立や非営利の学校では対応しきれない学生を受け入れていること、そして10年前の最もパフォーマンスの悪かった事業者のいくつかは、過去の取り締まりの中で既に市場から撤退していることを指摘しています。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Prospective Students
segments.tr: ## 進学希望者にとっての意味

segments.src: For borrowers weighing where to enroll, the data is a reminder to look beyond a school's marketing and check publicly available outcome measures before committing to a loan.
segments.tr: どこに入学するかを検討している借り手にとって、このデータは、学校のマーケティングだけでなく、ローンを組む前に公表されている成果指標を確認することを思い出させるものです。

segments.src: The Department of Education's College Scorecard and similar public tools allow students to compare completion rates, typical debt loads, and repayment outcomes by school and by program — information that can be far more useful than sector-wide averages when making an individual decision.
segments.tr: 教育省の「College Scorecard」や同様の公開ツールを使用すると、学生は学校ごと、プログラムごとの卒業率、典型的な借入額、返済成果を比較できます。これは、個人の意思決定を行う際に、セクター全体の平均値よりもはるかに有用な情報となります。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## より広い視野で

segments.src: This release adds another data point to a debate that has run through multiple administrations: how to balance access to postsecondary education — especially for adult and nontraditional learners — against the government's interest in protecting taxpayers and borrowers from programs that leave students worse off financially.
segments.tr: 今回のリリースは、複数の政権にわたって議論されてきたテーマに新たなデータポイントを加えるものです。それは、特に社会人やノントラディショナルな学習者に対する高等教育へのアクセスの確保と、学生の経済状況を悪化させるプログラムから納税者や借り手を保護するという政府の利益とのバランスをどのように取るかという問題です。

segments.src: Expect continued scrutiny, further rulemaking proposals, and likely pushback from industry groups as regulators digest what this new dataset shows.
segments.tr: 規制当局がこの新しいデータセットが示す内容を精査するにつれ、今後も厳しい監視、さらなる規則制定の提案、そして業界団体からの反発が予想されます。

segments.src: ## Why Nonpayment Rates Matter

segments.src: Consumer advocates argue that persistent, sector-wide gaps in repayment outcomes justify tighter accountability standards and clearer consequences for chronically underperforming programs.

segments.src: Rather than only counting borrowers who default outright (typically after 270+ days of missed payments), nonpayment metrics can also capture borrowers who are delinquent, in forbearance, or otherwise not actively paying down their balance.
segments.tr: Thay vì chỉ tính những người vay vỡ nợ hoàn toàn (thường sau hơn 270 ngày trễ hạn thanh toán), các chỉ số không thanh toán cũng có thể ghi nhận những người vay đang chậm trả, đang được hoãn thanh toán, hoặc không tích cực trả nợ gốc.

segments.src: That makes it a more sensitive early-warning indicator — but also one that requires careful interpretation, since forbearance and deferment are legitimate tools borrowers use during financial hardship, job loss, or continued enrollment.
segments.tr: Điều đó làm cho nó trở thành một chỉ báo cảnh báo sớm nhạy bén hơn — nhưng cũng là một chỉ báo đòi hỏi phải diễn giải cẩn thận, vì việc hoãn thanh toán và gia hạn là những công cụ hợp pháp mà người vay sử dụng trong thời gian gặp khó khăn tài chính, mất việc làm hoặc tiếp tục đi học.

segments.src: Analysts caution that a higher nonpayment rate doesn't automatically mean a school is failing its students.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích cảnh báo rằng tỷ lệ không thanh toán cao hơn không tự động có nghĩa là một trường học đang thất bại trong việc hỗ trợ sinh viên của mình.

segments.src: Enrollment patterns matter: for-profit programs have historically served a higher share of working adults, first-generation students, and people returning to education after time in the workforce — groups that, independent of where they studied, tend to carry more financial risk factors going into repayment.
segments.tr: Các mô hình tuyển sinh rất quan trọng: các chương trình vì lợi nhuận trong lịch sử đã phục vụ tỷ lệ cao hơn những người đi làm, sinh viên thế hệ thứ nhất và những người quay lại giáo dục sau thời gian làm việc — những nhóm người, bất kể họ đã học ở đâu, thường mang nhiều yếu tố rủi ro tài chính hơn khi bước vào giai đoạn trả nợ.

segments.src: ## The Policy Debate This Reopens
segments.tr: ## Cuộc tranh luận về chính sách mà điều này mở ra

segments.src: Still, the gap between sectors is large enough that it has revived questions about federal aid eligibility rules, including the Gainful Employment regulation, which ties some career-training programs' access to federal student aid to graduates' debt-to-earnings outcomes.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, khoảng cách giữa các lĩnh vực lớn đến mức nó đã làm sống lại các câu hỏi về các quy tắc đủ điều kiện nhận hỗ trợ liên bang, bao gồm quy định Việc làm có thu nhập (Gainful Employment), vốn gắn quyền tiếp cận hỗ trợ sinh viên liên bang của một số chương trình đào tạo nghề với kết quả nợ trên thu nhập của sinh viên tốt nghiệp.

segments.src: Consumer advocates argue that persistent, sector-wide gaps in repayment outcomes justify tighter accountability standards and clearer consequences for chronically underperforming programs.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ người tiêu dùng lập luận rằng sự chênh lệch dai dẳng, trên toàn ngành về kết quả trả nợ biện minh cho các tiêu chuẩn trách nhiệm giải trình chặt chẽ hơn và những hậu quả rõ ràng hơn đối với các chương trình hoạt động kém hiệu quả kéo dài.

segments.src: Representatives of the for-profit college sector have pushed back on drawing broad conclusions from aggregate data, noting that outcomes vary enormously by program, that many for-profit institutions serve students public and nonprofit schools are less equipped to reach, and that some of the worst-performing actors from a decade ago have already exited the market amid past enforcement actions.
segments.tr: Đại diện của lĩnh vực đại học vì lợi nhuận đã phản đối việc đưa ra các kết luận rộng rãi từ dữ liệu tổng hợp, lưu ý rằng kết quả khác nhau rất nhiều theo từng chương trình, rằng nhiều cơ sở vì lợi nhuận phục vụ những sinh viên mà các trường công lập và phi lợi nhuận ít được trang bị để tiếp cận hơn, và rằng một số tác nhân hoạt động kém hiệu quả nhất từ một thập kỷ trước đã rời khỏi thị trường trong bối cảnh các hành động thực thi pháp luật trước đây.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Prospective Students
segments.tr: ## Điều này có ý nghĩa gì đối với sinh viên tương lai

segments.src: For borrowers weighing where to enroll, the data is a reminder to look beyond a school's marketing and check publicly available outcome measures before committing to a loan.
segments.tr: Đối với những người vay đang cân nhắc nơi đăng ký học, dữ liệu này là một lời nhắc nhở hãy nhìn xa hơn các hoạt động tiếp thị của trường và kiểm tra các thước đo kết quả công khai trước khi cam kết vay nợ.

segments.src: The Department of Education's College Scorecard and similar public tools allow students to compare completion rates, typical debt loads, and repayment outcomes by school and by program — information that can be far more useful than sector-wide averages when making an individual decision.
segments.tr: Bảng điểm đại học (College Scorecard) của Bộ Giáo dục và các công cụ công cộng tương tự cho phép sinh viên so sánh tỷ lệ hoàn thành, mức nợ điển hình và kết quả trả nợ theo trường và theo chương trình — thông tin có thể hữu ích hơn nhiều so với mức trung bình toàn ngành khi đưa ra quyết định cá nhân.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Bức tranh toàn cảnh

segments.src: This release adds another data point to a debate that has run through multiple administrations: how to balance access to postsecondary education — especially for adult and nontraditional learners — against the government's interest in protecting taxpayers and borrowers from programs that leave students worse off financially.
segments.tr: Bản phát hành này bổ sung thêm một điểm dữ liệu vào cuộc tranh luận đã diễn ra qua nhiều chính quyền: làm thế nào để cân bằng quyền tiếp cận giáo dục sau trung học — đặc biệt là đối với người lớn và người học không truyền thống — với lợi ích của chính phủ trong việc bảo vệ người nộp thuế và người vay khỏi các chương trình khiến sinh viên rơi vào tình trạng tài chính tồi tệ hơn.

segments.src: Expect continued scrutiny, further rulemaking proposals, and likely pushback from industry groups as regulators digest what this new dataset shows.
segments.tr: Hãy chờ đợi sự giám sát liên tục, các đề xuất xây dựng quy tắc bổ sung và khả năng phản đối từ các nhóm ngành khi các cơ quan quản lý tiêu hóa những gì bộ dữ liệu mới này cho thấy.
